mechanism.claim: A high-variation completed eight-hour BTC move that rarely recrosses its causal cumulative traded-price anchor reflects persistent auction acceptance rather than two-way mean reversion. When the full block and final two hours agree, follow the accepted direction for eight hours.
mechanism.side: common strict sign of completed eight-hour and final-two-hour returns
mechanism.why_distinct: HVAVC counts the chronology of close crossings around a minute-updated cumulative quote/base VWAP. Existing VWAP candidates use one terminal gap or venue difference; path efficiency ignores volume anchors; sign-run features use zero rather than VWAP. HVAVC uses no funding, OI, cross-assets, prior event rows, fitted outcomes, or controls.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: the causal variation tail restricts activation to volatile blocks while low recrossing requires sustained auction acceptance instead of volatile anchor churn
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: three fixed UTC cumulative-anchor recross onsets are absent from Gross9 primitives

features.block: 480 exact coherent BTCUSDT bars_binance interval=1m rows [D-8h,D)
features.cumulative_vwap: cumulative quote_asset_volume divided by cumulative volume through each completed minute
features.anchor_sign: strict sign of log(close/cumulative_vwap); every minute must be nonzero
features.recross_count: count adjacent anchor-sign changes across the 480 completed minutes
features.recross_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 270 valid blocks, minimum 180, current excluded; rank<=0.25
features.realized_variation: sqrt(sum squared one-minute close returns), strict positive
features.variation_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 270 valid blocks, minimum 180, current excluded; rank>=0.65
features.block_return: log(last close/first open) over eight hours
features.late_return: log(last close/open at D-2h) over final two hours
features.direction_confirmation: block and late returns have one strict nonzero sign
features.onset: eligible now and immediately prior exact valid block ineligible; missing prior opportunity cannot trigger

clock.reservation: global half-open; exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not a signal input; exact settlements only after novelty passes

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

post_stage_volatility_audit.prerequisite: unchanged candidate passes train, test, eval, final

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

research_boundary.selection_basis: fixed cumulative quote/base VWAP recross count

stopping_rule: Terminal first-failure sequence: source support, Gross9 novelty, strict economics; no formula, rank, side, hold, clock, subset, or control repair.
